out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) walk-in cooler 2) 4DWR under flat top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PUT AN AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETER INSIDE THESE COOLERS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The following faucets were observed profusely leaking: 1) hand sink in the front 2) 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR FAUETS SO THEY CAN BE SHUT OFF WHEN NOT IN USE. CORRECT BY THE ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed staff member drink from an open container.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC DRINKING FROM OPEN CONTAINERS MUST BE DONE IN THE DINING AREA. CUPS WITH LIDS AND STRAW CAN BE CONSUMED IN THE KITCHEN AREA.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solutions in the red buckets was observed at 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. PIC REFRESHED THE RED BUCKETS WITH QUATERNARY AMMONIUM. WHEN TESTED, QUATERNARY AMMONIUM SOLUTION WAS OBSERVED AT 200-400ppm.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: miso soup
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE SOUP TO 205f. REHEAT ALL LEFTOVER SOUP TO 165f. AFTER REHEATING PROPERLY, SOUP MUST BE HOT HELD AT 135f OR HIGHER.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 2DR prep top sushi cooler; 2) 4DWR under flattop cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLACE AN AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETER IN THESE COOLERS.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Observed manufacturer containers of coffee creamer, garlic powder, and sushi ginger being used to store seasonings, sesame seeds, and panko.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REPLACE THE MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS WITH NSF APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, Provided
violations.observation: Observed employee personal belongings being stored on top of food in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide proper storage facilities for employees' personal belongings to prevent contamination of food, food equipment, and food contact surfaces. DESIGNATE A PLACE FOR ALL EMPLOYEE BELONGINGS TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION OF FOOD. BENTO HOUSE RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 02/20/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: scoop and tongs were observed being stored directly in the food of the 4DWR under flat top cooler.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PLEASE STORE UTENSILS WITH THE HANDLES NOT TOUCHING THE FOOD TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The hand sink next to the sushi station and the hand sink in the prep area were observed loose and not fixed to the wall.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. PLEASE FIX BOTH HAND SINK SO THEY ARE SECURELY ATTACHED TO THE WALL.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Facility is currently using quaternary ammonia for sanitizer. PIC presented chlorine test kit.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE PURCHASE A QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT. SEND EHS A PICTURE OR INVOICE ONCE PURCHASED.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: The bathrooms are not equipped with self-closing doors.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. PLEASE INSTALL SELF-CLOSING DOOR MECHANISM ON BOTH BATHROOM DOORS. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER SHALL BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. ENSURE THE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS PRESENT WHEN STAFF ARRIVE FOR PREPARATION. CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. EHS observed staff not washing hands before starting work, changing tasks, and before putting on gloves.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC ABOUT WHEN TO WASH HANDS. HANDS MUST BE WASHED BEFORE STARTING WORK, CHANGING TASKS, BEFORE PUTTING ON GLOVES, RETURNING FROM THE BATHROOM, ETC. SEE HANDWASHING FACTSHEET.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no handwashing sign in the men’s bathroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. POST A HANDWASHING SIGN IN THE MENS BATHROOM BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Observed staff using the same spatulas to cook raw chicken, raw beef, and raw seafood at the flat top.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures during storage and when processing. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TRAIN STAFF TO USE DIFFERENT SPATULAS AT THE FLAT TOP GRILL TO HANDLE RAW CHICKEN, RAW BEEF, AND RAW SEAFOOD AS SEAFOOD IS AN ALLERGEN. ENSURE TRAINING AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Observed staff dip a measuring cup in the sanitizer at the 3 compartment sink and proceeded to scoop chopped onions with it at the 4DWR flat top.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. ALLOW FOR DISHES TO COME IN CONTACT WITH SANITIZER FOR 1 MINUTE, THEN ALLOW IT TO AIR DRY BEFORE USING. BENTO HOUSE RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 03/06/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) miso soup (118f); 2) sushi rice (119f); 3) fried rice (127f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT THE MISO SOUP TO 165f AND TO HOT HOLD AT 135f OR HIGHER. EHS PROVIDED THE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL DOCUMENT FOR THE SUSHI RICE AND FRIED RICE.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS, BOTTLES, AND SHAKERS FOR WATER, OIL, SEASONINGS, SUGAR, SALT, RICE, ETC.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor of the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed deli containers, cups, and bowls lying in bulk bins of dried goods and soy sauce container.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. violations.observation: Manufacturer seaweed containers were observed reused for the storage of panko and cream cheese at the 2DR sushi prep top.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC TRANSFERS CREAM CHEESE TO A NSF APPROVED METAL CONTAINER AND DISCARDED THE PANKO. ENSURE ALL MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS ARE NOT REUSED FOR FOOD ELSEWHERE IN THE FACILITY. out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Observed frozen food stored in plastic take out bags in the walk in freezer.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. No proper instructions for response to bodily fluid cleanup posted in facility during time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided a copy of bodily fluid cleanup poster to PIC
